html:
The Phong Nha Cave Expedition by Kayak is an exciting adventure for travelers who love nature, exploration, and unique experiences.

Paddle through the dark passages of Phong Nha Cave, hike to hidden underground lakes, and discover ancient Cham writings in dry chambers.

This Phong Nha Tour offers a combination of kayaking, hiking, swimming, and cultural exploration, guided by experienced English-speaking guides for a safe and unforgettable adventure.

TOUR ITINERARY

09:00 – Pick up from your hotels in Phong Nha town.

09:30 – Tour guide introduces the program and prepares caving equipment.

10:30 – Practice kayaking at the cave entrance. Then start kayaking through the cave in darkness (first 3 kilometers).

12:00 – Finish kayaking and reach the hiking spot (1.5 km).

13:00 – Arrive at the secret underground lake and enjoy swimming in the dark water pool.

13:30 – Picnic lunch at the lunch spot.

14:00 – Hike and kayak back to the Phong Nha Cave entrance.

15:00 – Explore other dry chambers and see ancient Cham writings, remnants of the early human kingdom in Vietnam that followed Hinduism.

16:00 – Return to hotels, conclude the Phong Nha Cave Kayak Tour.

TOUR PRICE

70 US dollars per person (minimum 2 travelers).

INCLUSIONS

  • Transportation in Phong Nha town center

  • English speaking guide

  • Picnic lunch

  • Phong Nha Cave entrance fee

  • Boat and kayak equipment

  • Phong Nha caving gear

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips for guide/driver

CHILD POLICY

Children under 15 must travel under parents’ guidance.
